authoritative_for: The Decisions compatibility provider documents read-only access to retained version-one lifecycle events.
not_authoritative_for: It is not authoritative for new Krisis capture, Annals accounts, current decision force, or consumer policy.

covers: The sole supported retained Decisions lifecycle read surface.
excludes: Retired digest, review, email, scheduling, mutation, and all active Krisis operations are excluded.

shared_access_and_trust: The compatibility interface is a local-current-user read surface through the krisis executable.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Retained lifecycle events contain sensitive normalized legacy decision state and machine-local anchors; no retention horizon is promised.
compatibility_and_retirement: Provider release 0.4.0 preserves contract-version-one reads while Krisis appends no new events.
operational_limits: Only opaque-cursor watermark and bounded pagination are supported.
